name: Data Preview Process Quality Control
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewClarificationView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Process Quality Control Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has, plus an empty-state message for zero rows
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Clarification and this screen's business spec

UNLIKE Data Preview Threshing/Boiler Room: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section, per this station's explicit scope; all 16 non-time_slot detail columns (Shift, 12 numeric, QC Inspector ID, QC Engineering Corrective Actions, Findings) are rendered in the detail-row grid -- the MOST of any station in the project

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (DataPreviewProcessQualityControlView.spec.ts, 11 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's list/detail navigation flow in a live dev server.
